title: Agent capability and tier firewall
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for enforcing scoped effect ceilings, credential and high-entropy secret redaction, and model data-tier routing guards that block non-public payloads from training or contributor endpoints before dispatch.
boundaries: Any unknown effect_class, unknown data_sensitivity, or unknown endpoint_tier fails closed with verdict 'block'.
Enabling contributor_mode downgrades effective_endpoint_tier to contributor_shared, permitting public data only.
Human owners author capability policies; workers evaluate requests against pinned policies without widening grants.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for gating agent effects, scrubbing secrets, and enforcing model data-tier boundaries

value.lets_workers: Check tool actions against ordered effect ceilings and path/store allowlists, scrub credentials and high-entropy secrets without corrupting SHA-256 hashes, and block internal or confidential payloads from training or contributor model tiers.
value.not_for: Replacing OS kernel sandboxes or granting new credentials to workers.

flow.when: A human owner sets effect ceilings, store allowlists, and tier bounds.
Scrub credentials and PII from candidate payloads locally.
Run the combined effect, secret, and data-tier firewall before execution.
Record a tombstone whenever a dispatch is blocked.

nouns.title: Method: three-gate pre-dispatch evaluation (capability, secret scan, data tier)

lifecycle: author-capability-tier-policy pins the owner's effect ceiling and store/path scope.
scan-payload-for-secrets inspects outbound JSON and masks credentials while preserving hex commit/content hashes.
evaluate-pre-dispatch-gate combines effect ceiling, secret status, and endpoint retention tier into allow or block.
quarantine-blocked-dispatch turns blocked attempts into tombstones so workers do not retry forbidden routes.

nouns.title: Guardrail: actions exceeding max_effect_class, path prefixes, or destructive bans fail closed

value.rule: Every action is ordered on none(0) < read(1) < write-internal(2) < write-repo(3) < public(4); exceeding max_effect_class, escaping relative path prefixes, or matching destructive shell/SQL patterns blocks immediately.
value.how_it_is_checked: check_effect_ceiling evaluates rank, PurePosixPath traversal, store allowlists, and DESTRUCTIVE_CMD_RE.

nouns.title: Guardrail: internal, confidential, and secret payloads never route to training or contributor tiers

value.rule: Endpoints in trains_on_inputs or contributor_shared accept data_sensitivity='public' only; enterprise_no_train accepts up to 'internal'; zero_retention_isolated accepts up to 'confidential'; 'secret' is blocked from all external endpoints.
value.how_it_is_checked: check_model_tier_routing enforces ENDPOINT_TRAINING_TIERS and contributor_mode override.

nouns.title: Deterministic effect lattice, Shannon entropy rule, and endpoint data-tier matrix

value.entropy_rule: Tokens >= 26 chars with lowercase, uppercase, and digits and Shannon entropy >= 4.25 bits/char are masked unless 32..64-char hexadecimal digests.

nouns.title: Template: scoped worker capability and data-tier policy

value.describes: an owner-authored policy pinning maximum effect class, store/path allowlists, and redaction behavior

nouns.title: Template: outbound payload secret and PII scan report

value.describes: result of scanning and scrubbing an outbound payload prior to dispatch

nouns.title: Template: pre-dispatch capability and data-tier firewall decision

value.describes: auditable allow or block decision produced before a tool or model request executes
tombstone recording a blocked capability or model-tier route so workers do not repeat it

nouns.title: Deterministic checks for pre-dispatch firewall decision receipts

value.purpose: Deterministic checks every pre-dispatch firewall decision receipt must satisfy.

deterministic_checks.why: Every firewall evaluation terminates in an explicit allow or block verdict.
Blocked dispatches must record at least one machine-readable blocking reason.
Sanitized payloads stored in receipts must never retain raw private key headers.
The effective endpoint retention tier (after contributor-mode override) is mandatory.

nouns.title: Tool card: tier_firewall standard-library pre-dispatch evaluator

value.name: tier_firewall
value.runtime: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.
does: Enforces effect-class ceilings, path traversal bans, store allowlists, and destructive command blocks.
Redacts credentials, SSNs, and high-entropy tokens while preserving hex SHA-256 digests.
Blocks internal, confidential, or secret payloads from training or contributor model tiers.
does_not: Make network calls, store raw secrets in receipts, or widen caller permissions.

nouns.title: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications (Sensitive Information Disclosure & Excessive Agency)

value.provides: Threat taxonomy for Sensitive Information Disclosure (LLM02) and Excessive Agency (LLM06).

nouns.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 Security and Privacy Controls (AC-6 Least Privilege & SC-4 Information Flow)

value.provides: Least-privilege capability ceilings and information-flow enforcement across security tiers.

nouns.title: Worked example: synthetic blocked dispatch when contributor mode is active on confidential data

value.shows: Contributor mode downgrades a zero-retention endpoint to contributor_shared and blocks confidential context.

verbs.title: Author a scoped worker capability ceiling and model-tier policy
verbs.summary: A human owner defines the maximum effect class, permitted stores and relative path prefixes, and whether redacted payloads may proceed.
verbs.outcome: A pinned firewall policy for worker runs in that scope.
steps: Set max_effect_class to the narrowest level the workflow requires (read or write-internal by default).
List explicit allowed_stores and relative allowed_path_prefixes.

acceptance.check: max_effect_class is justified for the assigned task scope.

verbs.title: Scan and redact credentials and PII from an outbound payload
verbs.summary: Run tier_firewall's deterministic scanner over a candidate payload to mask API tokens, private key headers, SSNs, and high-entropy secrets.
verbs.outcome: A secret scan report carrying the sanitized payload.
steps: Run scan_and_redact_payload locally on the candidate outbound payload.
Verify 64-character hexadecimal content digests remain intact while secret tokens are masked.

verbs.title: Evaluate effect ceiling, secret status, and model data-tier routing before dispatch
verbs.summary: Run python3 -m tier_firewall evaluate on a candidate action and model endpoint against the pinned policy, returning an auditable allow or block decision.
verbs.outcome: A pre-dispatch firewall decision validated against firewall-decision-checks.

slots.name: policy
slots.description: Pin of the active firewall policy.

network: Executes local standard-library tier_firewall CLI only; never contacts external endpoints.
steps: Run tier_firewall evaluate locally with the candidate request and pinned policy.
Check the returned decision against firewall-decision-checks before proceeding.

verbs.title: Record a failure tombstone for a blocked capability or model-tier attempt
verbs.summary: Convert a blocked pre-dispatch decision into a reusable tombstone naming the violated ceiling or data-tier rule so workers switch to a compliant route.

slots.name: decision
slots.description: Pin of the blocked dispatch decision.

steps: Verify the pinned decision has verdict 'block' and non-empty reasons.
Write an avoid_rule stating which lower-effect action or higher-isolation endpoint tier is required instead.

acceptance.check: blocking_reasons matches the blocked decision's reasons.
